name: keep-the-thread
description: Compaction that keeps the thread: the transcript stays verbatim, stale tool results go, the moment is judged, and nothing leaves the machine unmasked.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepResultThreshold.title: Keep threshold (result)
keepResultThreshold.description: Below this Jev probability a tool result is truncated to its head. Recoverable: the assistant can re-run the tool. Lower is more conservative.

keepCallThreshold.title: Keep threshold (call)
keepCallThreshold.description: Below this Jev probability the call itself is removed with its result. Irreversible, so keep it well under the result threshold.

redact.title: PII masking
redact.description: Masking of the conversation sent to TypeSafe: 'standard' masks secrets, emails, IBANs, cards and account names; 'strict' adds phone numbers and public IPs; 'off' sends it raw. The compacted transcript is always verbatim.

protectErrors.title: Protect failed calls
protectErrors.description: Never remove a call whose result was an error: the failure is usually the constraint that matters.

gitleaks.title: Scan with gitleaks
gitleaks.description: Scan the conversation with the local gitleaks binary before sending it, and mask every secret it finds. On when gitleaks is installed; when it is not, the built-in patterns still apply and the session stops trying. Set to false to never run it.

gitleaksBinary.title: gitleaks binary
gitleaksBinary.description: Path to the gitleaks binary. Defaults to gitleaks on PATH.

gitleaksConfig.title: gitleaks config
gitleaksConfig.description: Path to a .gitleaks.toml to use instead of the default rules.

sideEffectTools.title: Side-effect tools
sideEffectTools.description: Comma-separated tools whose calls are never removed, only truncated, because re-running would not reproduce what they did. Defaults to Bash, Write, Edit, Task and the like; any mcp__ tool always counts.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

advise.title: Ask before auto-compacting
advise.description: Before an automatic compaction, ask Jev whether the session is at a boundary where compacting is safe, instead of going on the context percentage alone. A mid-task compaction is when losing tool results hurts most.

onBoundary.title: When the moment is right
onBoundary.description: What happens once the session is judged to be at a boundary: 'notify' says so on the notification bar and pins a line under the prompt, leaving the call to you; 'compact' compacts straight away. Either way the context ceiling still compacts on its own, because past it the built-in summary would take over instead.

guardRail.title: Leave a note after compacting
guardRail.description: Append a short note saying what the compaction removed and that a missing tool output is not evidence the work was done. A pruned history looks like a complete one, and an assistant reading its own unbacked turns can learn from them that work may be declared finished without showing it.

measureCache.title: Measure the cache cost
measureCache.description: Report what each compaction costs in rewritten prompt cache, next to the context it freed. Editing the history invalidates the cached prefix, and the context meter never shows that side of the trade. Free: it reads the turn usage and cost ledger the engine already holds.

alwaysCompactAtPercent.title: Compact without asking above
alwaysCompactAtPercent.description: Context percent past which the compaction runs without asking. The window is about to fill anyway, and a session must not stop compacting because the adviser is unreachable.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

cooldownTurns.title: Cooldown turns
cooldownTurns.description: Turns to let pass after a compaction before auto-compacting again.

minPercentDrop.title: Minimum context freed
minPercentDrop.description: Context points a compaction must win back. Below it the trigger is raised above the level that did not pay off, which is what stops a compaction loop.

maxAutoCompactions.title: Maximum auto-compactions
maxAutoCompactions.description: Hard stop on auto-compactions in one session.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

resultExcerptChars.title: Result excerpt shown to Jev
resultExcerptChars.description: Characters of each tool result shown to Jev in the question that asks whether to keep it. Without them Jev decides on the tool, its input, its success and its size alone, never the content. Carried by the question, which is sent once, not by the state, which is resent with every batch. 0 turns it off.
